blocks.text: SUBIC, Zambales — A marbled water monitor lizard, locally known as “bayawak,” was rescued here and brought to a wildlife rescue center for assessment and rehabilitation. The information comes from the Department of Environment and Natural Resources (DENR) Central Luzon said on Saturday, Oct. 10.
